course_name_original: Redes de comunicación y sistemas de información

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialization, at the necessary level to acquire the rest of the competences of the degree, including notions of the latest advances.
Awareness of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

The ability to analyze complex products, processes and systems in their field of study; to choose and apply appropriately established analytical, calculation and experimental methods and to correctly interpret the results of such analyses.

Ability to perform bibliographic searches, consult and critically use databases and other sources of information, to carry out simulation and analysis with the aim of conducting research on technical topics in their specialty.
Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with both engineers and people from other disciplines.
Ability to stay up-to-date with developments in science and technology.
To know and understand the computerization of the hospital system.

syllabus_topics: Communication protocols used in advanced monitoring networks
teaching_methods: Development, writing and presentation of reports, memos, audiovisual material, etc. related to projects/POPBLs, carried out individually or in teams
Individual study and work, tests, exams and/or control points
Presentation by the professor in the classroom, in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects
Realization of practices in workshops and/or laboratories, individually or in teams

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competences of the subject
Technical capacity, involvement in the project/PBL, work carried out, results obtained, documentation delivered, technical presentation and defense
Reports on exercise completion, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices

bibliography: B.P. Lathiand ZhiDing, “Modern Digital and Analog Communication Systems,” 3rd Edition, Oxford University Press, 2010
James F. Kurose and Keith W.Ross, “Computer networking: a top-down approach,” 6thEdition, Pearson, 2016
